llm.reply:
The records retrieved for this question are ClinVar sequence variants rather than phenotype annotations, beginning with ClinVar:16422 [1]. That record is named NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.6920G>C (p.Cys2307Ser) [1]. The phenotypic features themselves come from the linked MedGen record, titled Marfan syndrome [20].

## Retrieved FBN1 variants

One retrieved variant is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.8268G>A (p.Trp2756Ter) [3]. Another is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.3746G>C (p.Cys1249Ser) [5]. A further record is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.4987T>C (p.Cys1663Arg) [7]. The set also includes NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.6339T>G (p.Tyr2113Ter) [15].

## Additional variant records

The set includes NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.3350G>A (p.Cys1117Tyr) [11]. It also includes NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.6431A>G (p.Asn2144Ser) [17]. Another record is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.1643A>T (p.Asn548Ile) [19].

## MedGen clinical features

MedGen lists these clinical features: Aortic regurgitation [21], Arachnodactyly [22], Astigmatism [23], Ectopia lentis [24], Esotropia [25], Exotropia [26], Pes planus [27], Glaucoma [28], Congestive heart failure [29] and Hypertropia [30].
